# matter.js tests: the porting register

matter.js pin `862ad75f4d3c7ab528b8a3954168146082cad8a6` (`parity/schema.json` → `matter.sourceCommit`): 324 test files under `packages/node/test` and `packages/protocol/test`.
`ported`: the Go tests cover the file's `it` cases; `partial`: they cover some, the note names the rest;
`planned`: not ported yet; `excluded`: left out, with its class. The guard is `make testparity-check`.

## Planned

### node/test/behavior/cluster

- `ClusterBehaviorFeaturesTest.ts` — Feature selection of behaviors; its published-behaviors cases fix which features a matter.js server enables by default and that a selection violating FeatureMap conformance is refused on an endpoint, which the Go servers and device types must match.

### node/test/behavior/internal

- `MarkChangedTest.ts` — markChanged reports a computed attribute and advances its data version; the Go servers' change notification must show the same reporting and data-version rules.

### node/test/behavior/state/managed/values

- `ValuePatcherTest.ts` — Feature-dependent default fallbacks (omitted where a feature disallows a field, applied where it makes it mandatory, per feature set), which decide the defaults a Go server starts with.

### node/test/behavior/state/validation

- `conformanceTest.ts` — Field conformance of struct and command fields (outer resolution, element references, operational extension, revision conditions), checked through matter.js's validation table helpers.

### node/test/behavior/system/commissioning

- `CommissioningRestartTest.ts` — A node taken offline and started again stays commissionable when uncommissioned and can open a window when commissioned; the Go node's restart path must show the same.
- `CommissioningWindowTest.ts` — The controller-side window helpers (openEnhanced/openBasicCommissioningWindow with the pre-emptive revoke, AdminFabricIndex on fabric removal); the reference controller opens windows, without a ported case.
- `FabricBeforeStartTest.ts` — A fabric created before the node starts counts it as commissioned and advertises it operationally once online, in that order.
- `RemoteDescriptorTest.ts` — The controller's long-form record of a discovered device (addresses, hostname, D/VP fields, advertised SII/SAI/SAT kept apart from session parameters).

### node/test/behavior/system/controller/discovery

- `CommissioningIdentityTest.ts` — The commissioner's vendor/product identity check of an advertised device against the onboarding payload.
- `ContinuousDiscoveryTest.ts` — Continuous discovery creating one node for a device that concurrent discoveries report.
- `DiscoveryCancelTest.ts` — Cancellation and abort of a commissioning discovery before and after the PASE win, cancel reasons and settling.
- `DiscoveryErrorTest.ts` — The error kinds a commissioning discovery reports (not discovered, incomplete, aggregate, no transport, unusable device).
- `DiscoveryTransportsTest.ts` — Selection and reporting of the discovery transports (IP network, BLE) from the onboarding payload.

### node/test/behavior/system/dcl

- `DclBehaviorTest.ts` — The DCL configuration defaults (production/test URLs, certificate sources) and the offline switch of the DCL services.

### node/test/behavior/system/events

- `EventsBehaviorTest.ts` — Events of a former run dropped after stop/start unless the event store is non-volatile.

### node/test/behavior/system/network

- `ConnectionStateTest.ts` — The controller's per-peer connection state (Connected, Reconnecting, WaitingForDeviceDiscovery, Disconnected) and its transitions.
- `FabricLabelReconciliationTest.ts` — The controller pushing a drifted fabric label to a peer on start.

### node/test/behavior/system/sessions

- `SessionsBehaviorTest.ts` — Configured session intervals reaching the session manager, defaults kept for the unset ones, and reported session activity.

### node/test/behaviors/access-control

- `AccessControlCustomExtensionTest.ts` — A manufacturer extension of AccessControl (a custom attribute and command) served, advertised and reached from a controller.

### node/test/behaviors/commodity-tariff

- `CommodityTariffServerTest.ts` — Day entries without the randomization fields and a feature-mandatory member read as null when a write omits it.

### node/test/behaviors/energy-evse-mode

- `EnergyEvsModeServerTest.ts` — Local mode tags and the inherited mode-base commands of EnergyEvseModeServer.

### node/test/behaviors/fan-control

- `FanControlTest.ts` — Local mode tags and the not-off-only command set of FanControlServer by default.

### node/test/behaviors/general-diagnostics

- `GeneralDiagnosticsFeaturesTest.ts` — The DataModelTest feature against the node's paths-per-invoke limit.

### node/test/behaviors/groups

- `GroupsServerSchemaTest.ts` — The relaxed AddGroup GroupId/GroupName constraints, which leave the handler to answer out-of-range values with a command response.

### node/test/behaviors/icd-management

- `IcdManagementServerTest.ts` — The device-side ICD server (attribute defaults, constraints, counter, RegisterClient, StayActive), which milestone 5 phase 23 builds.
- `IcdModeTest.ts` — The ICD active/idle state machine of the device side, built with the ICD server in milestone 5 phase 23.

### node/test/behaviors/identify

- `IdentifyServerTest.ts` — TriggerEffect support following the device type's requirement, its withdrawal and explicit enablement.

### node/test/behaviors/measurement

- `MeasurementServersTest.ts` — The measurement servers' unavailable default range and the TemperatureMeasurement bound checks.

### node/test/behaviors/occupancy-sensing

- `OccupancySensingServerTest.ts` — OccupancySensing defaults and the OccupancyChanged event under the OccupancyEvent feature.

### node/test/behaviors/on-off

- `OnOffServerTest.ts` — OnWithTimedOff timing (0xFFFF holds, countdowns, writes during a countdown) and the OffOnly feature, which milestone 3 phase 17 ports.

### node/test/behaviors/operational-credentials

- `OperationalCredentialsServerTest.ts` — AddNOC admin vendor and certificate checks, SetVidVerificationStatement, UpdateNOC keeping the group state, and fabric changes under a bare fail-safe.

### node/test/behaviors/ota

- `OtaTest.ts` — The OTA requestor flow (query, Busy retries, apply, reboot, consent), which milestone 3 phase 19 ports.

### node/test/behaviors/power-source

- `PowerSourceServerTest.ts` — PowerSourceServer augmenting the descriptor of its endpoint.

### node/test/behaviors/rvc-operational-state

- `RvcOperationalStateServerTest.ts` — The RVC operational state server's base commands.

### node/test/behaviors/service-area

- `ServiceAreaServerTest.ts` — ServiceArea estimatedEndTime forms, the server without Maps and the supportedAreas validation.

### node/test/behaviors/switch

- `SwitchServerTest.ts` — The Switch server's validators, debounce and the latching and momentary press state machines, which milestone 3 phase 17 ports.

### node/test/behaviors/thermostat

- `AtomicWriteHandlerTest.ts` — Atomic writes (BeginWrite, CommitWrite, timeouts, per-peer holds), which milestone 3 phase 17 builds with the thermostat presets.
- `AtomicWriteStateTest.ts` — The atomic-write state emitting closed once, built with the atomic writes.
- `PresetsAtomicWriteTest.ts` — Writing presets through an atomic write.
- `PresetsConfigurationTest.ts` — Presets seeded from configuration and the write rules without configured presets.
- `PresetsLocalWriteTest.ts` — Local writes of presets: handles, persistence, validation per transaction.

### node/test/behaviors/thermostat-user-interface-configuration

- `ThermostatUserInterfaceConfgurationServerTest.ts` — KeypadLockout default, configuration and persistence across a restart.

### node/test/behaviors/thread-network-diagnostics

- `ThreadNetworkDiagnosticsProvisionalTest.ts` — Provisional ThreadNetworkDiagnostics attributes absent by default and present once supplied.

### node/test/behaviors/time-format-localization

- `TimeFormatLocalizationServerTest.ts` — Accepted and rejected date formats of TimeFormatLocalizationServer.

### node/test/behaviors/web-rtc-transport-requestor

- `WebRtcTransportRequestorServerTest.ts` — The WebRTC transport requestor server, which milestone 6 phase 26 builds.

### node/test/behaviors/window-covering

- `WindowCoveringServerTest.ts` — OperationalStatus change events on a target change and the lift/tilt type checks of a shutter.

### node/test/endpoint

- `EndpointNumberConflictTest.ts` — Refusal of an endpoint that claims a live endpoint's number, endpoint 0 or a sibling's id, and the retry after a failed add, as the node's PartsList shows it.

### node/test/endpoint/server

- `ProtocolServiceTest.ts` — The node's protocol service: fabric-filtered reads and writes, subscribe/notify, implemented-command and feature-map publication, deprecated globals and command-field validation.

### node/test/endpoint/type

- `SemanticNamespaceTest.ts` — The semantic tag namespaces: standard tags, custom namespaces and their use on an endpoint.

### node/test/endpoint/validation

- `ConstructionValidationTest.ts` — Device-type validation of a tree at construction: one pass per tree, strict refusal, singleton placement and crashed endpoints.
- `RuntimeValidationTest.ts` — Device-type validation after construction: destroyed children, changed device-type lists, added parts, factory reset.
- `StandardDeviceTypeCorpusTest.ts` — Every standard device type judged as built, and the Closure TagList requirement.

### node/test/endpoints

- `LargeBridgeTest.ts` — Instantiating, reading and destroying a bridge with many bridged devices in bounded time.

### node/test/node

- `ReportedSessionParametersTest.ts` — The session parameters the peer sent in PASE, CASE and resumed CASE, held by the controller. Left planned in BI-2: both cases assert both ends with configured intervals; fabrictest sets neither the controller's exchange.Config.LocalParameters nor the device's session intervals, and the device's record of what the controller sent has no accessor.
- `SplitCommissioningTest.ts` — A second controller completing a PASE-only commissioning a first one started, and its failure paths. Left planned in BI-2: controller/client has no completeCommissioning (only the first half exists: commissioner Options.FinalizeCommissioning) and fabrictest cannot share a CA and fabric between two controllers.

### node/test/node/client

- `PeersCommissionedTest.ts` — The controller's list of commissioned peers excluding discoveries and groups. Left planned in BI-2: the one case needs group nodes (peers.forAddress of a group id, nodeType "group"), which controller/client does not have (doc 'Not here: Groups'); the commissioned/discovered/forAddress split holds in TestRegistryRestore.
- `PeersLoadFailureTest.ts` — Keeping a fabric's other peers usable when one cannot load from storage. Left planned in BI-2: the Go registry drops a node that fails to load (logged once, registry.go NewRegistry; TestRegistryRestore) where matter.js keeps it with a rejected construction and a typed cause — a decision for the owner, not a port.

### protocol/test/action/client

- `ClientInteractionSubscribeTest.ts` — Every case drives ClientInteraction.close (ClientInteraction.ts:264-297) over its in-flight interaction set, the abandoned-subscribe termination (:1096, :1260-1300) or initBdx (:1185-1215); the Go Interaction has no Close, no in-flight tracking, no abandonment and no client BDX, and adding them spans subscribe.go/read.go/write.go (another agent's files) and is no small fix. Milestone 5 phase 25 (the controller remainder) brings ClientInteraction.close, the in-flight set and the abandonment; findings register (owner review of PR #164).

### protocol/test/dcl

- `DclVendorInfoServiceSeedTest.ts` — The subject, matter.js DclVendorInfoService seeding from a bundled vendor snapshot (DclVendorInfoService.ts, SeedTypes.ts), has no Go counterpart in controller/dcl; the service is a feature for the owner. With DclVendorInfoServiceTest, milestone 6 phase 27 (owner review of PR #164).
- `DclVendorInfoServiceTest.ts` — The subject, matter.js DclVendorInfoService (packages/protocol/src/dcl/DclVendorInfoService.ts, 497 lines: vendor fetch, storage, field normalisation, built-in vendors, update timer, productInfoFor), has no Go counterpart in controller/dcl; the ledger read it builds on is Client.Vendors (DclClientTest), the service itself is a feature for the owner. Milestone 6 phase 27 (completeness) brings the vendor information service; findings register (owner review of PR #164).

### protocol/test/icd

- `CheckInMessageTest.ts` — The ICD Check-In message nonce, encoding and decoding against the specification vectors, built with the ICD server in milestone 5 phase 23.
- `FabricIcdTest.ts` — The fabric's ICD registrations (device role) and Check-In processing (controller role), milestone 5 phases 23 and 24.
- `IcdCheckInBackOffTest.ts` — The device's doubling Check-In back-off, milestone 5 phase 23.
- `IcdCheckInSenderTest.ts` — The device's Check-In sender, milestone 5 phase 23.
- `IcdCheckInSuppressionTest.ts` — Suppressing a Check-In when a subscription covers the monitored subject, milestone 5 phase 23.
- `IcdCounterTest.ts` — The device's ICD counter (boot bump, wrap at 2^32), milestone 5 phase 23.

### protocol/test/peer

- `NetworkProfileTest.ts` — matter.js's NetworkProfiles (per-medium throttle semaphores, additive MRP margins, connect/probe sub-profiles) has no Go counterpart: controller/peer documents network profiles as out of scope by ADR 0020's stage split (the LAN is the one network, MRP margins are 0), and porting the class is a feature, not a fix. Milestone 5 phase 25 (the controller remainder) brings the network profiles; findings register, "Network profiles" (owner review of PR #164).
- `PeerConnectionSocketOwnershipTest.ts` — Ownership of the channel a pairing opens: the UDP (and, for the commissioner, BLE) rule applies now, the TCP describe with the TCP initiator of milestone 5 phase 25.
